title.zh: 访问所有节点的最短路径

desc.zh: 从重复经过中心的星形走法，推导记录当前位置与访问集合的多起点搜索。
desc.en: Derive a search over current nodes and visited sets from a walk that revisits a star’s center.

complexity: O((n+m)2^n) expected time; O(n2^n) auxiliary space, m = undirected edges

concepts.name: BFS with visited-set state
concepts.description: Merge histories only when both endpoint and visited set agree.

concepts.name: Multi-source shortest path
concepts.description: Initialize every allowed starting node at distance zero.
